The word itself matches. A pre-listed platform waiver of the parity skill.

Android lays this 18 pt Rubik line 1.4 pt wider than Chrome (ink 350.7 vs 349.3 pt, gate 1 pt): same Rubik-Regular.ttf, same size and line box, the same line breaks, subpixel and linear text already on through React Native's CustomStyleSpan; Android's glyph advances for Rubik add up wider at 3x and no style changes advances (nudging glyphs is banned). iOS passes it. Evidence: reports/e18/android-waiver-candidates.json and the run's crops/consent.body.png.
